北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力较大，体感寒冷，注意防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is quite windy and feels very cold. Remember to keep warm and windproof!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿冷，体感 2℃，请注意添衣防潮。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and damp-cold, feels like 2℃. Please dress warmly and mind the humidity.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，体感 3℃，记得穿暖和点哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and a bit cool, feels like 3℃. Remember to dress warmly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气舒适，体感 18℃，阴天出门带件薄外套。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is comfortable, feels like 18℃. Take a light jacket for overcast days.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，气温 21℃，心情也会跟着晴朗！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen enjoys lovely sunshine and 21℃. Your mood will be sunny too!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州湿冷，体感 -1℃，记得多穿保暖衣物哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is damp-cold, feels like -1℃. Remember to wear more warm clothes!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 -2℃，注意防寒保暖，别感冒了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast and cold, feels like -2℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天微凉，体感 4℃，记得穿暖和点哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and a bit cool, feels like 4℃. Remember to dress warmly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 -2℃，出门记得多穿点，小心着凉。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and cold, feels like -2℃. Dress warmly when going out to avoid catching a cold.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天湿冷，体感 -2℃，湿度 100%，出门小心路滑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and damp-cold, feels like -2℃ with 100% humidity. Be careful of slippery roads.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾，体感 6℃，能见度低，请注意交通安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, feels like 6℃. Low visibility, please mind traffic safety.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -26℃，滴水成冰，最强御寒装备穿起来！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -26℃, extremely cold! Bundle up with your warmest gear!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴但体感 -17℃，出门别忘了戴帽子手套哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -17℃. Don't forget your hat and gloves when going out.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云微凉，体感 9℃，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and a bit cool, feels like 9℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天风力大，体感 13℃，出门小心防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and windy, feels like 13℃. Remember to protect yourself from the wind when going out!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风大体感 -8℃，多穿点，海边风更冷哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is windy and feels like -8℃. Dress warmly, it's even colder by the sea.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 5级，体感 -15℃，防寒保暖，别被风吹透了！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very windy (level 5), feels like -15℃. Stay warm and protect yourself from the wind!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级
